book.name: IOANES
book.title: No Tahut na Hinhinawas IOANES ga Pakat Ia

content: Iesu ga sasaring bia no ana Sus na hapuasnei no minarina
Ing Iesu ga tangai tar kaiken, ga nanaas uram ra mawai gaam sasaring hoken: “Mama, no pakana bung i ta hanuat. Hapuasnei no minarina no Natim waing no Natim naga hapuasnei no minamarim.
U na gil at hoing u ga tar ra dadas tana bia na warkurai manaliu ta ira tunatuna bakut waing na tar no nilon hathatikai ta diet bakut ing u ta tar diet tana.
Ma iakan no nilon hathatikai, bia diet na nunurei uga, uga no kapawena Kalou tutun, ma bia diet na nunurei mah Iesu Karisito nong u ta tulei ia ukai.
Iau ta hapuasnei no minamarim kai tano ula hanua ing iau hapataam ira pinapalim u ga tar bia iau na me gil.
Io, Mama, kaiken uga iat u na hapuasnei no minamarigu, iakano minamar iau ga hatur kahai ia tikai ma uga naluai ing ga taia baa ta ula hanua.
Iesu ga sasaring uta ira nuna bulu na hausur
“Iau ta hapuasnei tar uga ta diet ing u ga tar diet tagu, io, pa diet gar tano ula hanua. A num diet ma u ga tar diet tagu ma diet ta taram ira num nianga.
Kaiken diet ta nunurei um bia ira linga bakut u ta tar tagu i hanuat maram at taam.
Diet ta nunurei um kanong ira nianga u ga tar tagu iau ga tar ta diet ma diet ga kap timaan lah. Diet gaba nunurei tar at bia iau ga hansur maram taam ma diet gaam nurnur bia u ga tulei iau.
Ma iau, iau sasaring uta diet. Iau pai sasaring utano ula hanua. Senbia iau sasaring uta diet ing u ta tar tagu kanong a num diet.
Ira linga bakut tikai ma diet a num, ma ira num, a nugu. Ma diet ta hapuasnei ira minamarigu.

Iau wara hinahaan talur um iakan ra ula hanua uram taam. Senbia diet a baa ken tano ula hanua. Halhaliana Mama, his bat diet ma no dadas tano hinsaam, no hinsaam nong u ga tar ia tagu, waing diet naga tikai mon haruat datar, datar mon tikai.

Ing iau ga kis tikai taar ma diet iau ga his bat diet ma no dadas ta iakano hinsang u ga tar ia tagu. Iau ga balaurei tar diet ma taia tikai ta diet i ta panim laah, senbia nong sena mon nong ga murmur hani no ngaas na hinirua, ia kaik i ta panim laah waing ira num nianga di ga pakat na hanuat tutun.

“Dahina um ma iau na hanhut ukatika taam, senbia iau tangai kaiken ra linga ing iau baa kanik tano ula hanua. Ma iau tangtangai kaiken waing diet naga hung ma no nugu gungunuama ta ira nudiet nilon hoing i hung taar tagu.
Iau ta tar ira num nianga ta diet ma no ula hanua i ta malentakuanei diet kanong pa diet makai tano ula hanua, hoing mah iau pa iau makai tano ula hanua.
Pa iau saring uga bia u na kap lah diet talur no ula hanua. Taia. Iau saring uga bia u na his bat lah diet talur no Tena Sakena.
Pa diet makai tano ula hanua hoing mah iau pa iau makai tano ula hanua.
Hapalainei ira num tutun ta diet bia naga bul hasisingen diet bia diet naga hanuat a num mataniabar. Ira num nianga i tutun.
Iau ta tulei tar diet tano ula hanua hoing u ga tulei tar iau tano ula hanua.
Iau bul hasisingen habal iau tupas uga wara uta diet, waing diet mah diet naga kis sisingen pas no ula hanua bia diet naga hanuat a num mataniabar.

“Senbia pa iau sasaring uta diet sena mon. Taia. Iau sasaring mah uta diet ing diet na ra hadadei no hinhinawas ta kan ra kabana ma diet na nurnur tagu, waing diet bakut diet na tikai mon. Mama, iau sasaring bia diet na kis ta datar ma diet na tikai mon, hoing uga, u kis tagu, ma iau, iau kis taam, waing no ula hanua na nurnur bia u ga tulei iau.
No minamar nong u ga tar ia tagu iau ta tar mah ia ta diet bia diet na tikai mon hoing datar tikai mon.

Diet na tikai mon kanong u kis tagu ma iau kis ta diet. Io hua, iau sasaring bia na ngan hua ing diet na tiga kapawena mon waing no ula hanua na nunurei bia u ga tulei iau ma bia u ta sip diet hoing u ta sip iau.

“Mama, iau sip diet ing u ta tar diet tagu bia diet na kis tikai ma iau tano sibaan iau na kis kaia. Iau sip hua waing diet na nas no minamarigu, no minamarigu nong u ta tar ia tagu kanong u ga sip iau naluai tano hakhakisi tano ula hanua.
“Takodasiana Mama, no ula hanua pai nunurei uga senbia iau nunurei uga ma diet ira num diet nunurei bia u ga tulei iau.
Iau ta hapalainei tar uga ta diet. Ma iau na madung wara hapalainei diet taam waing no num sinisip utagu na kis ta diet ma bia iau mah, iau na kis ta diet.”
